_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); ratings, education and information signals

pit_profile.why: S&P Global 'is a leading provider of transparent and independent ratings, benchmarks, analytics and data to the capital and commodity markets worldwide' (Item 1); Item 1A: 'Changes in the volume of securities issued and traded in domestic and/or global capital markets, asset levels and flows into investment products, changes in interest rates and volatility in the financial markets, and volatility in the commodities markets could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition or results of operations.', and no risk factor calling a business cyclical; a fall in debt issuance or the markets it serves cuts revenue, and no disruption theme is live for the business on this date

classification.quality_note: S&P Global 'is a leading provider of transparent and independent ratings, benchmarks, analytics and data to the capital and commodity markets worldwide' (Item 1); Item 1A: 'Changes in the volume of securities issued and traded in domestic and/or global capital markets, asset levels and flows into investment products, changes in interest rates and volatility in the financial markets, and volatility in the commodities markets could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition or results of operations.', and no risk factor calling a business cyclical; a fall in debt issuance or the markets it serves cuts revenue, and no disruption theme is live for the business on this date. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 23.01x; +90% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.77; conservative 2yr -21%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -39.1%/yr (worst year FY07-FY16, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +3.0%/yr (FY17 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +11.7%/yr (FY07-FY16 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +43.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY07-FY16); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: SPGI (retrospective, 2017-12-01) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 23.01x (80.7% downside to Bear $32 / +3.5% upside to Bull $172) | Adj composite 1.50 vs market 3.27: gap -1.77 [OVERVALUED] | +89% above the EPP floor $88 (14x FY17E $6.26) | Conservative 2-yr case: -21.1% total (-10.6%/yr) | At 26.5x FY17E the 15% hurdle price $220 sits above the BULL case; Financial Services revenue +9.1% in Q3 2017, forward revenues +0% (FY17 revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
